check.notes: No text, logos, labels or watermark found anywhere — the bag face, globe, roses and floor are all blank. One thing to verify at full resolution: the watch dial (approx x 42.5, y 69.5, w 4, h 4) carries faint indistinct markings that could resolve into garbled pseudo-text or a fake brand name at print size; it was too small to read here. Other observations: the globe is cropped hard at the top and left edges, so it reads as a partial object; the gold pour reads as frozen/solid metal rather than flowing liquid where it meets the bag rim, and the rivulet down the bag's left edge merges with the puddle in a slightly melted, unphysical way; the bag's left side panel and the gold coating overlap with no clear shadow separating bag from floor — the bag casts almost no ground shadow, so it floats slightly against the white backdrop; no people or hands in frame, so no finger/anatomy issues.
